sources.fullCitation: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester. “Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen?” Slowfox aus dem Tonfilm „Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung“. Gloria, Katalog-Nr. G.O. 10197, side marked b, matrix Bi 412, 1932. The uploader's description transcribes the label as crediting the music to “Dr. Bronislaw Kaper – Walter Jurmann” and the words to “Fritz Rotter”, and names the quartet; the disc itself is not shown in the YouTube upload. Uploaded 19 June 2014. Accessed 21 August 2026.
